items.title: Hal Espinosa interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 20, 2024
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...we have the “Cry of the Wild Goose” by Frankie Laine... [INTERVIEWEE] I remember them all.

ctx.x: So going back to this list, if you’re thinking about eventually a career as a trumpet player, I was just interested in a few of the songs off this list from 1950 and we have the “Tennessee Waltz” by Patti Page, “Cry of the Wild Goose” by Frankie Laine, and the “Third Man Theme” by the fellow who used to play on New Year’s Eve, remember Guy Lombardo?
